post.text:
President Trump exits the room after hearing about the death of Chuck Norris 🚨

You can tell this one really got to him 😞 https://t.co/YvF0mOkqPS
post.author_description: I make original music videos on X about trending topics and news events for a living. Pretty awesome to be able to say that! :) ⠀⠀ ⠀ ⠀ ⠀

description.description: A capture from a video sequence showing various indoor scenes. The first frame shows Donald Trump from behind, speaking to a group of men including a Marine officer with numerous service ribbons. The second frame shows young men in dark blazers sitting in a group. The third frame shows a blurry crowd of people, including a photographer with a camera. The fourth frame shows photographers and journalists crowded around a doorway, with one individual taking a photo with a smartphone while another cameraman stands on a ladder.
